reuse.why: Extends the existing shared weekend helpers (getDateWithSkippedWeekend, isSkippedWeekendDay, findNextOccurrence, skipsWeekendDays) and the existing applyWeekendRule instead of adding new paths.

duplication.why: One isWeekendOrHoliday predicate drives moving and skipping; the only repetition is threading config.holidays into each getDateWithSkippedWeekend call.

placement.why: The holiday predicate and the window bounds sit in shared/schedules.ts beside the weekend rule, and the local WEEKEND_SHIFT_MAX_DAYS constant moves there as a function.

scope.why: Type, parse, helper and call-site edits plus tests, all needed for holidays.

maintainability.why: Clean and central; the only fragility is that each caller must remember to pass holidays as a separate argument rather than the helper taking the config.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every weekend site (getNextDate, applyWeekendRule, getWeekendMovedDay, isSkippedWeekendDay in schedule-template) goes through the shared helpers.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the holiday check exists once in isWeekendOrHoliday.

one_place.where: isWeekendOrHoliday in shared/schedules.ts, used by getDateWithSkippedWeekend, isSkippedWeekendDay and findNextOccurrence, which all schedule paths call.
